name: Bingban's Prison Palace
source:
When four adults find themselves trapped within a strange afterlife prison run by  a bubbly warden of death known as Bingban, their only hope of returning back to their lives is by playing a fatal game of Truth or Dare, but something seems off about this whole thing...

[From [url=https://chrismason-01.itch.io/bingbans-prison-palace]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
四个成年人被困在一座奇怪的来世监狱。负责看管他们的是个活泼开朗的死亡典狱长，名叫宾班。要想回到生前的日子，他们唯一的指望就是玩一场可能致命的“真心话大冒险”。可整件事，好像哪里不太对劲…

〔摘自[url=https://chrismason-01.itch.io/bingbans-prison-palace]itch.io[/url]〕
